title: Ingrown toenail surgeries
summary: Discover the causes and symptoms of ingrown toenails, and how minor surgical procedures can offer fast and lasting relief.
intro: An ingrown toenail happens when the edge of the nail grows into the skin, causing pain, swelling, and sometimes infection.
If the condition persists or becomes recurrent, a simple surgical removal of the nail edge or full nail may be necessary to prevent further complications.
causes: Wearing tight or narrow shoes that crowd the toes
Improper nail trimming (cutting nails too short or rounded)
Injury to the toe or repeated pressure
benefits: Surgical removal of the affected nail portion provides immediate relief, reduces infection risk, and helps prevent recurrence.
